paragraphs.text: Tobita (TOH-bih-tah) Master of Elements was a human wizard from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War .

Before he became an Elementalist, Tomoya was a simple Student of Elements in Minamo . After he reached master jushi status with expertise in air magic , Tobita wore a white robe with a pattern of purple swirls, purple sashes, and an ivory headpiece, with his long white hair and beard flowing free.
